metadata.description: Read-only snapshot of the user's Verified Storm Impacts catalogue. Refresh after editing the sheet; text is not live.

2003_tr0031.impact_summary: Beni was a named cyclone in the 2003–04 South-West Indian Ocean season but is not reported to have made landfall in Madagascar.
2003_tr0031.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2003_tr0034.impact_summary: Cela brought widespread rainfall to Madagascar, including 317 mm in 24 hours at Morombe.

2004_tr0009.landfall_area: Mahajanga (first landfall); Mananjary and Morondava later
2004_tr0009.impact_summary: Elita made three landfalls in Madagascar, killing at least 33 people and leaving more than 55,000 homeless.

2004_tr0014.impact_summary: Gafilo struck northeastern Madagascar, killing at least 363 people and causing about US$250 million in damage.
2004_tr0014.verification_notes: 220 km/h landfall wind reported in Wikipedia.

2004_tr0013.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2004_tr0025.verification_notes: WATTCH supplies BENTOJANA, but Wikipedia's 2004–05 season lists Bento, not BENTOJANA. Bento remained offshore, but do not assign this identity or its impacts without confirming the label.

2005_tr0009.impact_summary: Ernest killed 78 people in Madagascar; its rain and winds caused serious damage in the south before Felapi followed.

2005_tr0013.impact_summary: Felapi brought additional flooding rain to southern Madagascar just days after Ernest, with 157.2 mm reported at Morondava.

2005_tr0031.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2006_tr0006.impact_summary: Boloetse followed an erratic track across Madagascar and killed six people when it brushed the southwestern coast.
2006_tr0006.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2006_tr0011.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2006_tr0014.impact_summary: Diwa developed into a large severe tropical storm near the Mascarene Islands and later became extratropical without a documented Madagascar landfall.
2006_tr0014.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2006_tr0020.impact_summary: Elia was a moderate tropical storm in March 2006, with no Madagascar landfall described in the season account.
2006_tr0020.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2006_tr0025.impact_summary: Anita reached moderate tropical storm intensity in November 2006, then weakened under stronger wind shear without making landfall in Madagascar.
2006_tr0025.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2006_tr0027.impact_summary: Bondo struck northwestern Madagascar, killing 11 people and leaving around 20,000 homeless.

2006_tr0029.impact_summary: Clovis killed four people in Madagascar and left 13,465 homeless as flooding damaged homes, crops and infrastructure.

2007_tr0011.impact_summary: Enok developed east of Madagascar and later affected St. Brandon; no Madagascar landfall is reported in the season account.

2007_tr0012.impact_summary: Favio passed south of Madagascar, bringing heavy rain that blocked roads, before striking Mozambique as an intense cyclone.
2007_tr0012.verification_notes: Do not use Favio's Mozambique landfall intensity for Madagascar.

2007_tr0013.impact_summary: Gamede generated exceptional rainfall on Réunion and brushed eastern Madagascar with rain and wind, but its centre did not make landfall there.
2007_tr0013.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2007_tr0017.impact_summary: Indlala killed 150 people in Madagascar, damaging or destroying around 54,000 houses and leaving over 188,000 homeless.

2007_tr0018.impact_summary: Jaya brought flooding to northern Madagascar shortly after Indlala, killing one person and leaving 8,015 homeless.

2007_tr0027.impact_summary: Bongwe formed and dissipated over the Indian Ocean in November 2007; no Madagascar landfall is listed in the season's effects table.
2007_tr0027.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2007_tr0029.impact_summary: Celina weakened and dissipated east of southeastern Madagascar, without a documented landfall there.
2007_tr0029.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2007_tr0033.impact_summary: Elnus was a moderate tropical storm near Madagascar, but the season account reports no significant damage or fatalities.
2007_tr0033.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2008_tr0013.impact_summary: Fame struck northwestern Madagascar, killing at least 13 people and leaving around 20,000 homeless.

2008_tr0014.landfall_area: North of Fenoarivo Atsinanana / Sainte-Marie area
2008_tr0014.impact_summary: Ivan devastated eastern Madagascar, with 93 people initially reported dead and more than 330,000 left homeless.

2008_tr0010.impact_summary: Hondo reached intense tropical cyclone strength over the Indian Ocean; the season account identifies effects around Mauritius and Réunion rather than Madagascar landfall.
2008_tr0010.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2008_tr0019.impact_summary: Jokwe affected northern Madagascar before crossing the Mozambique Channel and making a destructive landfall in Mozambique.
2008_tr0019.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2008_tr0026.impact_summary: Asma affected northern Madagascar in October 2008; the season table records one death.
2008_tr0026.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2008_tr0029.impact_summary: Cinda weakened to a remnant low offshore east of Madagascar in December 2008 without making landfall.
2008_tr0029.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2009_tr0008.impact_summary: Fanele made landfall in western Madagascar, causing destructive flooding and wind damage, with 10 deaths recorded in the season summary.
2009_tr0008.verification_notes: Landfall wind value not distinguished from lifetime maximum; left blank.

2009_tr0022.impact_summary: Jade made landfall near Antalaha and brought damaging rain and winds to Madagascar; the season summary records 15 deaths.
2009_tr0022.verification_notes: Fatalities from season effects; landfall sustained wind not separately stated.

2009_tr0027.impact_summary: Bongani was a moderate tropical storm affecting Madagascar, Mayotte and the Comoros, but the season article does not establish a Madagascar landfall.
2009_tr0027.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2009_tr0031.impact_summary: David was a moderate tropical storm whose affected areas included Madagascar, Mauritius and Réunion; its exact effects on Madagascar were not quantified.
2009_tr0031.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2010_tr0005.impact_summary: Edzani became a very intense tropical cyclone over the open Indian Ocean, with no Madagascar impacts listed in the season effects table.
2010_tr0005.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2010_tr0006.impact_summary: Fami strengthened over the Mozambique Channel and made landfall on Madagascar's western coast before rapidly weakening.
2010_tr0006.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2010_tr0013.impact_summary: Gelane was an intense tropical cyclone whose season entry lists Madagascar among affected areas, but does not report a Madagascar landfall.
2010_tr0013.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2010_tr0017.impact_summary: Hubert made landfall near Mananjary as a severe tropical storm and weakened rapidly while crossing Madagascar.
2010_tr0017.verification_notes: Landfall time 21:00 UTC in cyclone-season timeline.

2010_tr0025.impact_summary: Subtropical Depression Joël developed over the Mozambique Channel and affected Mozambique and Madagascar, with only minimal reported damage.
2010_tr0025.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2010_tr0026.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2011_tr0013.impact_summary: Bingiza crossed Madagascar several times, killing 34 people and destroying 25,464 homes.

2011_tr0029.impact_summary: Dando was a subtropical depression associated with flooding in southern Africa, rather than a Madagascar landfall.
2011_tr0029.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.
2011_tr0029.name_check: name listed in wikipedia season; Named storm verified; appears in two WATTCH event IDs (2011_tr0029 and 2012_tr0006), possibly duplicate real-world cyclone across year boundary.

2012_tr0006.impact_summary: Dando produced flooding in South Africa and Mozambique; no Madagascar landfall is reported for this named system.
2012_tr0006.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.
2012_tr0006.name_check: name listed in wikipedia season; Named storm verified; appears in two WATTCH event IDs (2011_tr0029 and 2012_tr0006), possibly duplicate real-world cyclone across year boundary.

2012_tr0009.impact_summary: Funso became an intense tropical cyclone in the Mozambique Channel and affected Mozambique and Malawi without making landfall in Madagascar.
2012_tr0009.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2012_tr0014.impact_summary: Giovanna made landfall near Andovoranto and crossed Madagascar, bringing destructive winds and flooding.
2012_tr0014.verification_notes: Season article lists at least 35 deaths across the region, so Madagascar-only toll left blank.

2012_tr0015.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2012_tr0016.impact_summary: Irina crossed Madagascar twice and caused at least 65 deaths on the island, many in the Ifanadiana district.
2012_tr0016.verification_notes: At least 65 Madagascar fatalities reported as of 6 March.

2012_tr0024.impact_summary: Anais reached intense tropical cyclone strength over the Indian Ocean, but only its weakened remnants reached Madagascar on 19 October.
2012_tr0024.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2012_tr0032.impact_summary: Dumile passed through the Mascarene Islands region in early January 2013 rather than making landfall on Madagascar.
2012_tr0032.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2013_tr0014.landfall_area: Around 55 km south of Morombe, southwestern Madagascar
2013_tr0014.impact_summary: Haruna caused severe flooding in southwestern Madagascar, killing at least 24 people and leaving nearly 10,000 homeless.

2013_tr0020.impact_summary: Imelda formed in April 2013 and remained offshore, with no Madagascar landfall recorded in the season history.
2013_tr0020.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2013_tr0023.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2013_tr0026.impact_summary: Amara developed into an intense cyclone over the Indian Ocean in December 2013 without documented Madagascar landfall.
2013_tr0026.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2014_tr0006.impact_summary: Deliwe's developing circulation brought flooding to Madagascar's Melaky region, killing at least two people and leaving 463 homeless in Mahajanga.
2014_tr0006.verification_notes: Named Deliwe after the system left Madagascar; not a named-storm landfall.

2014_tr0015.impact_summary: Guito formed over the Mozambique Channel in February 2014 and strengthened into a severe tropical storm without a Madagascar landfall.
2014_tr0015.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2014_tr0025.impact_summary: Adjali approached the northern end of Madagascar in November 2014 but stayed offshore and dissipated.
2014_tr0025.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2015_tr0003.impact_summary: Chedza struck an already flood-affected Madagascar, killing 80 people and displacing 54,792.

2015_tr0015.impact_summary: Rainfall associated with the developing Haliba flooded eastern Madagascar, killing 26 people and leaving approximately 39,000 homeless.
2015_tr0015.verification_notes: Heavy rain occurred during early development; not a confirmed named-storm landfall.

2015_tr0013.verification_notes: WATTCH labels this storm UNNAMED. Wikipedia season name matching cannot distinguish its historical identity. Leave historical impact and observed landfall intensity unassigned until an independent storm designation is established.

2015_tr0017.impact_summary: Joalane developed over the open Indian Ocean, travelled southward and dissipated without a reported Madagascar landfall.
2015_tr0017.verification_notes: No Madagascar impacts identified in season account.

2016_tr0007.impact_summary: Daya brought heavy rain to parts of Madagascar in February 2016 while developing offshore, but no landfall was recorded.
2016_tr0007.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2016_tr0018.impact_summary: Abela developed over the southwest Indian Ocean in July 2016, with no Madagascar landfall reported in the season account.
2016_tr0018.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2017_tr0003.impact_summary: Carlos was a tropical storm in early 2017 whose principal documented effects were around the Mascarene Islands rather than Madagascar landfall.
2017_tr0003.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2017_tr0005.impact_summary: Dineo formed over the Mozambique Channel and made landfall in Mozambique in February 2017, not Madagascar.
2017_tr0005.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2017_tr0009.landfall_area: Sava Region, between Antalaha and Sambava
2017_tr0009.impact_summary: Enawo struck northeastern Madagascar, killing 78 people and causing severe destruction in Antalaha and Maroantsetra.
2017_tr0009.verification_notes: 205 km/h estimated just before landfall; verify exact landfall fix.

2017_tr0026.impact_summary: Ava struck Madagascar, killing at least 73 people and leaving around 51,000 homeless, with losses estimated at US$195 million.
2017_tr0026.verification_notes: Peak 150 km/h (10-minute) occurs near landfall, but separate landfall wind not established.

2018_tr0013.impact_summary: Eliakim made landfall in Madagascar and caused widespread flooding that killed at least 21 people and left 19,400 homeless.
2018_tr0013.verification_notes: Peak wind is not necessarily landfall wind.

2018_tr0020.impact_summary: Fakir brought torrential rainfall, flooding and landslides to Réunion in April 2018, with no Madagascar landfall reported.
2018_tr0020.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2019_tr0008.impact_summary: Eketsang's precursor and rainbands caused heavy rainfall and landslides in Madagascar, killing 27 people and flooding more than 1,700 homes.
2019_tr0008.verification_notes: Named phase developed after crossing Madagascar; not a named-storm landfall.

2019_tr0013.impact_summary: Idai formed near Mozambique, intensified over the Mozambique Channel and made its devastating landfall north of Beira rather than in Madagascar.
2019_tr0013.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2019_tr0026.impact_summary: Belna damaged around 80% of roofs in Soalala and killed nine people in Madagascar, causing at least US$25 million in losses.

2020_tr0009.impact_summary: The disturbance that later became Diane brought severe flooding to northern Madagascar, killing 31 people and inundating more than 10,600 homes.
2020_tr0009.verification_notes: Diane was named only after leaving Madagascar; no named-storm landfall intensity.

2020_tr0013.impact_summary: Francisco made landfall near Mahanoro, flooding neighbourhoods and causing one reported death when a house collapsed in Vatomandry.
2020_tr0013.verification_notes: Peak 85 km/h was before landfall; do not enter as landfall wind.

2020_tr0028.impact_summary: Bongoyo developed over the Indian Ocean in December 2020 without a documented Madagascar landfall.
2020_tr0028.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2020_tr0033.impact_summary: Chalane crossed Madagascar as a tropical depression, bringing 203 mm of rain in 24 hours to Toamasina and some localised damage.
2020_tr0033.verification_notes: Storm intensified later over Mozambique Channel; later peak not Madagascar landfall wind.

2020_tr0034.impact_summary: Danilo was a named tropical storm in the 2020–21 season, with no Madagascar landfall reported in the season history.
2020_tr0034.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2021_tr0010.impact_summary: Eloise crossed northern Madagascar, causing one death and damaging or destroying about 190 homes.
2021_tr0010.verification_notes: Do not confuse Madagascar landfall with much stronger later Mozambique landfall.

2021_tr0019.impact_summary: Faraji reached very intense tropical cyclone strength over open water in February 2021 and did not make landfall in Madagascar.
2021_tr0019.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2021_tr0025.impact_summary: Iman was a named tropical storm in March 2021 with its principal reported impacts outside Madagascar and no Madagascar landfall in the season history.
2021_tr0025.verification_notes: Landfall intensity blank: not a verified named-storm landfall wind observation.

2022_tr0006.impact_summary: The depression that later became Ana crossed eastern Madagascar and caused severe flooding and landslides, killing 58 people and leaving about 55,000 homeless.
2022_tr0006.verification_notes: Crossed as tropical depression before receiving name Ana over Mozambique Channel.

2022_tr0007.impact_summary: Batsirai devastated southeastern Madagascar, killing 121 people and damaging or flooding more than 17,000 homes.
2022_tr0007.verification_notes: 165 km/h at landfall in WMO article; confirm averaging period.

2022_tr0009.impact_summary: Cliff remained at sea while Batsirai affected Madagascar; the season account reports no landfall by Cliff.
2022_tr0009.verification_notes: No Madagascar impacts identified in season account.

2022_tr0014.impact_summary: Dumako made landfall in Madagascar as a tropical storm after struggling to intensify offshore.
2022_tr0014.verification_notes: Madagascar-specific wind and losses not established from season overview.

2022_tr0019.impact_summary: Gombe crossed northern Madagascar before intensifying over the Mozambique Channel and later striking Mozambique.
2022_tr0019.verification_notes: Do not use stronger later Mozambique landfall intensity.

2022_tr0025.impact_summary: Jasmine crossed Madagascar near Toliara and weakened to an overland depression after a previous landfall in Mozambique.
2022_tr0025.verification_notes: Madagascar impacts not quantified in season overview.

2023_tr0004.impact_summary: Cheneso caused widespread flooding in Madagascar, killing 33 people and damaging more than 23,600 homes.
2023_tr0004.verification_notes: Peak 140 km/h was attained later over ocean, NOT at Madagascar landfall.

2023_tr0007.impact_summary: Dingani strengthened into a tropical cyclone in February 2023 over the Indian Ocean without making landfall in Madagascar.
2023_tr0007.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2023_tr0009.impact_summary: Freddy made landfall near Mananjary in Madagascar, where 17 deaths were reported and more than 14,000 homes were affected.
2023_tr0009.verification_notes: 175 km/h is a 1-minute wind; not directly comparable with RSMC 10-minute speeds.

2023_tr0020.impact_summary: Alvaro made landfall in Madagascar's Morombe District, producing damaging winds and losses estimated above US$1 million.
2023_tr0020.verification_notes: Season article quotes 140 km/h winds but averaging convention and landfall estimate inconsistent with peak-intensity summary; left wind blank.

2024_tr0012.impact_summary: Eleanor brought wind and rain to Mauritius and Réunion, with no Madagascar landfall listed in the season's effects table.
2024_tr0012.verification_notes: No Madagascar impacts identified in season account.

2024_tr0015.impact_summary: Filipo passed near Madagascar before bringing destructive wind and rain to Mozambique, where substantial housing and infrastructure damage was reported.
2024_tr0015.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2024_tr0018.impact_summary: Gamane brought destructive flooding to northern Madagascar, killing 19 people and affecting at least 90,000 people.
2024_tr0018.verification_notes: 150 km/h landfall estimate in UNICEF report; averaging period to confirm.

2024_tr0025.impact_summary: Bheki brought heavy rain to Rodrigues and Réunion in November 2024 but did not make landfall in Madagascar.
2024_tr0025.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.

2024_tr0027.impact_summary: Chido passed near northern Madagascar but caused its major documented destruction in Agaléga, Mayotte and Mozambique; the season article does not report a Madagascar landfall.
2024_tr0027.verification_notes: No Madagascar landfall wind available unless independently sourced. Wikipedia season-page summary.
